scanNote: KITOB XATOSI (16-mashq): yo'riqnoma 'Complete PETER'S letter to MICK' deydi, lekin berilgan xat 'Dear PETER ... Best wishes, MICK' — ya'ni bu MIKNING PITERGA yozgan JAVOB xati. To'g'ri yo'riqnoma: 'Complete Mick's letter to Peter'. 15-mashqdagi xat esa haqiqatan Piterdan Mikka.

exercises.explanationUz:
13-MAShQNING OXIRGI BESh BANDI
(58-betdan davom etadi)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   6  SHOULD
   7  CAN
   8  SHOULDN'T
   9  MUSTN'T
  10  SHOULDN'T


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 6  'Andy SHOULD take the bus instead of the
     car TO SAVE MONEY.'
    KALIT: 'TO SAVE MONEY' — maqsad IJOBIY,
    demak maslahat ham ijobiy.
    'can't take the bus' bo'lsa maqsad bilan
    mos kelmaydi.
    → SHOULD

 7  'It's cold! CAN you close the window,
     please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    'Must you close the window?' = 'derazani
    yopishingiz SHARTMI?' — g'alati.
    → CAN

 8  'You SHOULDN'T leave the electricity on
     when you go on holiday.'
    Ta'tilga ketganda chiroqni yoqib qoldirish
    — ISROF, lekin QONUNIY taqiq emas.
    Demak MASLAHAT → SHOULDN'T.
    ('can't leave' = 'qoldira olmaysiz' —
     jismonan mumkin, demak mos emas.)
    → SHOULDN'T

 9  'You MUSTN'T drink and drive.'
    Ichib mashina haydash — KO'P MAMLAKATDA
    QONUNAN TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.
    'can drink and drive' = 'ichib haydashingiz
    mumkin' — juda xavfli maslahat.
    → MUSTN'T

10  'You SHOULDN'T forget to lock your door
     before you leave the house.'
    Bu — MASLAHAT (eslatma) → SHOULDN'T.
    'can't forget' = 'unuta olmaysiz' —
    ma'nosiz (unutish har kimning qo'lidan
    keladi).
    → SHOULDN'T


ENG NOZIK FARQ — 8, 9, 10:

  Uchalasi ham 'nima qilmaslik kerak'
  haqida, lekin:

   8  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (isrofgarchilik)
   9  MUSTN'T   — QONUNIY TAQIQ (ichib haydash)
  10  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (eslatma)

  Grammar 60-bet ta'rifi:
  'mustn't means it is FORBIDDEN ...
   it is AGAINST THE RULE'

  Faqat 9-band qonunga tegishli.


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T' NIMA UChUN MOS EMAS:
  'can't' = imkoni yo'q / ruxsat yo'q.

   8  'You CAN'T leave the electricity on'
      = chiroqni yoqib qoldira OLMAYSIZ
      (lekin jismonan qoldirish mumkin)
  10  'You CAN'T forget to lock your door'
      = eshikni qulflashni unuta OLMAYSIZ
      (lekin unutish mumkin)

  Ikkalasi ham mantiqan noto'g'ri.


DIQQAT — 'INSTEAD OF':
  'take the bus INSTEAD OF the car'
  = mashina O'RNIGA avtobus

  'instead OF + OT/-ING'
  'instead' (yolg'iz) = o'rniga
  (Coursebook 100-bet: 'special slippers to
   wear INSTEAD')


DIQQAT — 'DRINK AND DRIVE':
  'to drink and drive' = ichib mashina
  haydamoq (turg'un ibora).

  'Don't drink and drive' — dunyo bo'ylab
  mashhur xavfsizlik shiori.


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE THE ELECTRICITY ON':
  'leave ... ON' = yoqib qoldirmoq
  Teskarisi: 'turn ... OFF' = o'chirmoq

  Coursebook 98-bet, 1-mashqdagi qo'shimcha
  g'oyalardan: 'Turn off the lights when you
  leave a room.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  instead of      = ... o'rniga
  to save money   = pul tejamoq
  to close        = yopmoq
  electricity     = elektr
  to leave ... on = yoqib qoldirmoq
  to drink and drive = ichib haydamoq
  to lock         = qulflamoq

items.textEn: 6  Andy can't/should take the bus instead of the car to save money.
items.uz: Endi pul tejash uchun mashina o'rniga avtobusda yurishi kerak.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — MAQSAD GAPI:
'TO SAVE MONEY' (pul tejash uchun) — maqsad
IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy → SHOULD.

'can't take the bus' = 'avtobusda yura
olmaydi' — maqsad bilan mos kelmaydi.

'INSTEAD OF the car' = mashina o'rniga.
Coursebook 98-bet: 'Use buses and trams —
not cars.'

items.textEn: 7  It's cold! Must/Can you close the window, please?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.

'CAN you ...?' — birovdan iltimos qilish
shakli.
'MUST you close the window?' = 'derazani
yopishingiz SHARTMI?' — g'alati savol.

Odobliroq shakl: 'COULD you close the
window, please?'

items.textEn: 8  You shouldn't/can't leave the electricity on when you go on holiday.
items.uz: Ta'tilga ketganingizda elektrni yoqib qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
Bu — MASLAHAT (isrofgarchilikning oldini olish),
QONUNIY taqiq EMAS → SHOULDN'T.

'can't leave' = 'qoldira olmaysiz' — lekin
jismonan qoldirish mumkin, demak mantiqan
noto'g'ri.

'to leave ... ON' = yoqib qoldirmoq
(teskarisi: 'turn ... OFF' = o'chirmoq).

Ichib mashina haydash — KO'P MAMLAKATDA
QONUNAN TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

Grammar 60-bet: 'mustn't means it is
FORBIDDEN ... against the rule'.

'can drink and drive' = 'ichib haydashingiz
mumkin' — juda xavfli va noto'g'ri.

'Don't drink and drive' — dunyo bo'ylab
mashhur xavfsizlik shiori.

DIQQAT: 8 va 10-bandlar 'shouldn't' (maslahat),
bu esa 'mustn't' (qonun) — farqi shu.

items.textEn: 10  You can't/shouldn't forget to lock your door before you leave the house.
items.uz: Uydan chiqishdan oldin eshikni qulflashni unutmasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
Bu — MASLAHAT (eslatma) → SHOULDN'T.

'can't forget' = 'unuta OLMAYSIZ' — ma'nosiz,
chunki unutish har kimning qo'lidan keladi.

'shouldn't FORGET to ...' = unutmasligingiz
kerak (= 'should REMEMBER to ...').

'before you LEAVE' — 'before' dan keyin
to'liq gap ham kelishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below and fill in the blanks with the correct modal verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri modal fe'l bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  CAN ... CAN'T
  3  MUST
  4  SHOULD
  5  MUSTN'T


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  A: My eyes are tired.
    B: You SHOULD wear your glasses.
    (A: Ko'zlarim charchadi.
     B: Ko'zoynagingizni taqishingiz kerak.)

 2  A: CAN I go outside to play?
    B: No, you CAN'T. It's raining.
    (A: Tashqariga o'ynagani chiqsam
        bo'ladimi?
     B: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

 3  A: Do I have to go to school?
    B: Yes you do. You MUST go to school.
    (A: Maktabga borishim shartmi?
     B: Ha, shart. Maktabga borishingiz kerak.)

 4  A: I want to go on holiday this Christmas.
    B: You SHOULD start saving some money.
    (A: Bu Rojdestvoda ta'tilga bormoqchiman.
     B: Pul yig'ishni boshlashingiz kerak.)

 5  A: I'm sorry I'm late, Mrs Brown.
    B: You MUSTN'T be late for school again.
    (A: Kechikkanim uchun uzr, Missis Braun.
     B: Boshqa maktabga kechikmasligingiz
        kerak.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'My eyes are TIRED' — muammo bor,
    do'stona MASLAHAT kerak → SHOULD.

 2  Bola RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?
    Javob: qisqa javob savolni takrorlaydi
    → 'No, you CAN'T.'
    Sababi: 'It's RAINING.'

 3  KALIT: savolda 'DO I HAVE TO ...?' —
    MAJBURIYAT so'ralyapti.
    Javobda 'Yes you DO' + 'You MUST ...'
    (Coursebook 101-bet, 12-mashq bilan
     AYNAN bir xil naqsh:
     'Do I have to make the bed?'
     'Yes, you do. You must make the bed.')

 4  'I WANT to go on holiday' — maqsad bor,
    unga erishish uchun MASLAHAT → SHOULD.

 5  KALIT: 'I'm sorry I'm LATE' va 'AGAIN' —
    bu TAKRORLANGAN qoidabuzarlik.
    O'qituvchi QAT'IY ogohlantirmoqda
    → MUSTN'T (maktab qoidasi).
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa juda yumshoq bo'lardi.


MODALLAR — QAY BIRI QAChON (qisqa jadval):

  SHOULD   — do'stona maslahat      (1, 4)
  CAN      — ruxsat so'rash          (2)
  CAN'T    — ruxsat bermaslik        (2)
  MUST     — majburiyat              (3)
  MUSTN'T  — qat'iy taqiq/ogohlantirish (5)


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDAGI IKKI SHAKL:
  Savolda:  'DO I HAVE TO go to school?'
  Javobda:  'Yes you DO. You MUST go.'

  Nega ikki xil? Chunki savolda 'Must I ...?'
  zamonaviy inglizchada kam ishlatiladi;
  'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.
  Javobda esa 'must' ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'AGAIN':
  'You mustn't be late for school AGAIN.'
  'again' — bu birinchi marta EMASligini
  ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun ogohlantirish
  QAT'IY.

  'late FOR school' — predlog 'for'
  (Workbook 57-bet, 6-mashqning 1-bandi).


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'START SAVING':
  'start SAVING' — 'start' dan keyin -ING
  ('start TO save' ham to'g'ri).

  'to save money' = pul yig'moq/tejamoq.
  Grammar 62-bet: 'Tonia is SAVING some
  money.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  glasses      = ko'zoynak (DOIM ko'plik)
  outside      = tashqariga
  to save money = pul yig'moq
  Christmas    = Rojdestvo
  to be sorry  = uzr so'ramoq

items.sentence: 1  A: My eyes are tired.  B: You ...................................... wear your glasses.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'My eyes are TIRED' — muammo bor, do'stona
MASLAHAT kerak → SHOULD.

'must wear' bo'lsa juda qat'iy bo'lardi
(bu maktab qoidasi emas, do'stona maslahat).

'glasses' = ko'zoynak — DOIM ko'plikda
('a glass' = stakan, boshqa ma'no).

Bola RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?

'Must I go outside?' = 'chiqishim SHARTMI?'
— ma'nosiz.

'go outside TO play' — MAQSAD to-infinitive.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN I go?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'

Sababi gapda berilgan: 'It's RAINING.'

'mustn't' bo'lsa juda qat'iy — bu qonuniy
taqiq emas, ob-havo tufayli rad etish.

items.sentence: 3  A: Do I have to go to school?  B: Yes you do. You ......................... go to school.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: savolda 'DO I HAVE TO ...?' —
MAJBURIYAT so'ralyapti → javobda MUST.

Coursebook 101-bet, 12-mashq namunasi AYNAN
shunday:
  'Do I have to make the bed?'
  'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

Nega ikki xil shakl? Savolda 'Must I ...?'
zamonaviy inglizchada kam ishlatiladi.

items.sentence: 4  A: I want to go on holiday this Christmas.  B: You ......................... start saving some money.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'I WANT to go on holiday' — maqsad bor,
unga erishish uchun do'stona MASLAHAT
→ SHOULD.

'must start saving' bo'lsa juda qat'iy —
bu majburiyat emas, tavsiya.

'start SAVING' — 'start' dan keyin -ING
('start TO save' ham to'g'ri).

items.sentence: 5  A: I'm sorry I'm late, Mrs Brown.  B: You ............................. be late for school again.

commonMistake.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT:
  1) 'Mrs Brown' — o'qituvchi, ya'ni MAKTAB
     QOIDASI haqida gapiryapti
  2) 'AGAIN' — bu birinchi marta EMAS,
     demak ogohlantirish QAT'IY

→ MUSTN'T

'shouldn't be late' bo'lsa juda yumshoq
bo'lardi (do'stona maslahat kabi).

'late FOR school' — predlog 'for'.

exercises.instructionEn: The letter from Peter to Mick
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Mick,

  I'm afraid I have some bad news. While we
  were on holiday some thieves broke into our
  house.

  They broke in through the back door and
  nobody heard anything because we live quite
  far from the other houses. Nobody saw
  anything because it was dark. They stole our
  jewellery from the bedroom and the TV and
  video from the living-room. They also took
  the money that I had in the kitchen.

  Now I can't sleep at night because I'm afraid
  it will happen again. I don't know how to
  protect the house. Do you have any advice?

                            Best wishes,
                            Peter


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Mik,

  Afsuski, yomon xabarim bor. Biz ta'tilda
  bo'lganimizda uyimizga o'g'rilar bostirib
  kirishdi.

  Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi va hech kim hech
  narsa eshitmadi, chunki biz boshqa uylardan
  ancha uzoqda yashaymiz. Hech kim hech narsa
  ko'rmadi, chunki qorong'i edi. Ular yotoqxonadan
  taqinchoqlarimizni, mehmonxonadan televizor va
  videoni o'g'irlashdi. Oshxonada turgan pulimni
  ham olib ketishdi.

  Endi kechasi uxlay olmayman, chunki yana
  takrorlanishidan qo'rqaman. Uyni qanday himoya
  qilishni bilmayman. Maslahatingiz bormi?

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Piter


ZAMONLAR — HAMMASI PAST SIMPLE:
  broke into, broke in, heard, saw, was, stole,
  took

  Chunki voqea TUGAGAN.

  Faqat oxirgi xatboshi HOZIRGI zamonda:
  'Now I CAN'T sleep', 'I'M afraid',
  'I DON'T KNOW' — chunki bu hozirgi holat.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (xatdan):
  break → BROKE → BROKEN
  hear  → HEARD → HEARD
  see   → SAW   → SEEN
  steal → STOLE → STOLEN
  take  → TOOK  → TAKEN


DIQQAT — 'BREAK INTO' va 'BREAK IN':
  'break INTO a house' = uyga bostirib kirmoq
     (to'ldiruvchi BOR)
  'break IN' = bostirib kirmoq
     (to'ldiruvchi YO'Q)

  Xatda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan:
     'thieves BROKE INTO our house'
     'They BROKE IN through the back door'


DIQQAT — 'STEAL' va 'ROB' FARQI:
  'to STEAL something' = narsani o'g'irlamoq
     'They stole our jewellery.'
  'to ROB somebody/a place' = birovni/joyni
     o'g'irlab ketmoq
     'They robbed the bank.'

  'steal' — NARSA; 'rob' — JOY yoki ODAM.


DIQQAT — 'NOBODY ... ANYTHING':
  'NOBODY heard ANYTHING.'
  = hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi

  Inglizchada IKKI INKOR ishlatilmaydi:
     'Nobody heard anything.'  ✓
     'Nobody heard nothing.'   ✗

  'nobody' allaqachon inkor, shuning uchun
  keyingi so'z 'anything' (nothing emas).


DIQQAT — 'QUITE FAR FROM':
  'quite far FROM the other houses'
  'far FROM' — predlog 'from'
  (Grammar 63-bet: 'close TO' ↔ 'far FROM')

  'quite' = ancha, ancha-muncha.


DIQQAT — 'THE MONEY THAT I HAD':
  'the money THAT I had in the kitchen'
  'that' — ergash gap bog'lovchisi
  ('which' ham bo'lardi; tushirib qoldirish
   ham mumkin: 'the money I had').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  I'm afraid   = afsuski (yumshoq boshlanish)
  bad news     = yomon xabar (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  while        = ... paytda
  a thief      = o'g'ri (ko'pligi THIEVES)
  to break into = bostirib kirmoq
  the back door = orqa eshik
  quite far    = ancha uzoq
  dark         = qorong'i
  to steal     = o'g'irlamoq
  jewellery    = taqinchoqlar (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a bedroom    = yotoqxona
  the living-room = mehmonxona
  to happen    = sodir bo'lmoq
  to protect   = himoya qilmoq
  advice       = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN)

points.en: I'm afraid I have some bad news. While we were on holiday some thieves broke into our house.
points.uz: Afsuski, yomon xabarim bor. Biz ta'tilda bo'lganimizda uyimizga o'g'rilar bostirib kirishdi.
points.noteUz:
'I'm afraid' — yomon xabarni yumshatib
aytish shakli.
'a thief' → ko'pligi THIEVES (f → ves).
'break INTO' — to'ldiruvchi bilan.

points.en: They broke in through the back door and nobody heard anything because we live quite far from the other houses.
points.uz: Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi va hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi, chunki biz boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda yashaymiz.
points.noteUz:
'break IN' — to'ldiruvchisiz.
'NOBODY heard ANYTHING' — ikki inkor YO'Q!
'far FROM' — predlog 'from'.

points.en: Nobody saw anything because it was dark.
points.uz: Hech kim hech narsa ko'rmadi, chunki qorong'i edi.
points.noteUz:
'IT was dark' — ob-havo/holat egasi 'it'.
see → SAW (noto'g'ri fe'l).

points.en: They stole our jewellery from the bedroom and the TV and video from the living-room.
points.uz: Ular yotoqxonadan taqinchoqlarimizni, mehmonxonadan televizor va videoni o'g'irlashdi.

points.en: They also took the money that I had in the kitchen.
points.uz: Oshxonada turgan pulimni ham olib ketishdi.
points.noteUz:
take → TOOK.
'the money THAT I had' — ergash gap
('that' tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin).

points.en: Now I can't sleep at night because I'm afraid it will happen again.
points.uz: Endi kechasi uxlay olmayman, chunki yana takrorlanishidan qo'rqaman.
points.noteUz:
'NOW' — hozirgi zamonga o'tish.
'I'm afraid' bu yerda = qo'rqaman (boshqa
ma'no!).
'it WILL happen' — bashorat.

points.en: I don't know how to protect the house. Do you have any advice?
points.uz: Uyni qanday himoya qilishni bilmayman. Maslahatingiz bormi?
points.noteUz:
'HOW TO + fe'l' = qanday qilishni.
'ADVICE' — SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'any advice' ('any advices' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  What happened when Peter was on holiday?
    → Some thieves broke into his house.
    (Uyiga o'g'rilar bostirib kirishdi.)

 2  How did the thieves get in?
    → They broke in through the back door.
    (Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi.)

 3  Why didn't anybody hear anything?
    → Because they live quite far from the
      other houses.
    (Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda
     yashaydi.)

 4  Why didn't anybody see anything?
    → Because it was dark.
    (Chunki qorong'i edi.)

 5  What did the thieves steal?
    → They stole his jewellery from the
      bedroom, the TV and video from the
      living-room and the money he had in the
      kitchen.
    (Ular yotoqxonadan taqinchoqlarni,
     mehmonxonadan televizor va videoni,
     oshxonadan pulni o'g'irlashdi.)

 6  Why can't Peter sleep at night?
    → Because he is afraid it will happen
      again.
    (Chunki u yana takrorlanishidan
     qo'rqadi.)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR JAVOB MATNDA:

  1  →  1-xatboshi:
        'some thieves BROKE INTO our house'
  2  →  2-xatboshining boshi:
        'They broke in THROUGH THE BACK DOOR'
  3  →  2-xatboshi:
        'because we live QUITE FAR FROM the
         other houses'
  4  →  2-xatboshi:
        'because IT WAS DARK'
  5  →  2-xatboshi:
        'They STOLE our jewellery ... the TV
         and video ... the money'
  6  →  3-xatboshi:
        'because I'M AFRAID IT WILL HAPPEN
         AGAIN'


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — OLMOSHLARNI O'ZGARTIRING:

  Xat BIRINCHI shaxsda yozilgan ('I', 'we',
  'our'), lekin javob UChINChI shaxsda
  bo'lishi kerak ('he', 'they', 'his'):

     Xatda:  'OUR house'
     Javobda: 'HIS house'

     Xatda:  'WE live far from'
     Javobda: 'THEY live far from'

     Xatda:  'the money that I had'
     Javobda: 'the money HE had'

     Xatda:  'I'M AFRAID'
     Javobda: 'HE IS AFRAID'

  Bu — savolga javob berishning eng ko'p
  unutiladigan qismi!


SAVOL TURLARI:
  WHAT happened?    →  voqea
  HOW did they ...? →  usul
  WHY didn't ...?   →  sabab ('Because ...')
  WHAT did they ...? → narsa


DIQQAT — 'WHY' SAVOLIGA JAVOB:
  'WHY didn't anybody hear anything?'
  → 'BECAUSE they live quite far ...'

  'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob
  beriladi.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-SAVOLDAGI 'ANYBODY':
  'Why didn't ANYBODY hear anything?'

  INKOR savolda 'nobody' emas, 'ANYBODY':
     'Didn't anybody hear?'  ✓
     'Didn't nobody hear?'   ✗

  Lekin TASDIQ gapda 'nobody':
     'NOBODY heard anything.' ✓


DIQQAT — 2-SAVOLDAGI 'GET IN':
  'How did the thieves GET IN?'
  'to get in' = kirmoq (og'zaki)
  = 'to break in' (bu holatda)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to happen    = sodir bo'lmoq
  to get in    = kirmoq
  anybody      = hech kim (inkor savolda)
  to steal     = o'g'irlamoq

points.en: 1  What happened when Peter was on holiday?  —  Some thieves broke into his house.
points.uz: Piter ta'tilda bo'lganida nima sodir bo'ldi? — Uning uyiga o'g'rilar bostirib kirishdi.

points.en: 2  How did the thieves get in?  —  They broke in through the back door.
points.uz: O'g'rilar qanday kirishdi? — Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi.
points.noteUz:
Xatning 2-xatboshisidan.
'to get in' = 'to break in' (bu holatda).
'THROUGH the back door' — predlog 'through'.

points.en: 3  Why didn't anybody hear anything?  —  Because they live quite far from the other houses.
points.uz: Nega hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi? — Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda yashaydi.
points.noteUz:
'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob.
DIQQAT: 'WE live' → 'THEY live'.
'far FROM' — predlog 'from'.

points.en: 4  Why didn't anybody see anything?  —  Because it was dark.
points.uz: Nega hech kim hech narsa ko'rmadi? — Chunki qorong'i edi.
points.noteUz:
Xatdan so'zma-so'z.
'IT was dark' — holat egasi 'it'.

points.en: 5  What did the thieves steal?  —  They stole his jewellery from the bedroom, the TV and video from the living-room and the money he had in the kitchen.
points.uz: O'g'rilar nimani o'g'irlashdi? — Ular yotoqxonadan taqinchoqlarni, mehmonxonadan televizor va videoni, oshxonadan pulni o'g'irlashdi.

points.en: 6  Why can't Peter sleep at night?  —  Because he is afraid it will happen again.
points.uz: Nega Piter kechasi uxlay olmaydi? — Chunki u yana takrorlanishidan qo'rqadi.
points.noteUz:
Xatning 3-xatboshisidan.
DIQQAT: 'I'M afraid' → 'HE IS afraid'.
'to be afraid' = qo'rqmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete Peter's letter to Mick using the prompts below.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ KITOB XATOSI — YO'RIQNOMADA:
  Kitob 'Complete PETER'S letter to MICK'
  deydi, lekin berilgan xat:
     'Dear PETER ... Best wishes, MICK'

  Ya'ni bu MIKNING PITERGA yozgan JAVOB xati!
  To'g'ri yo'riqnoma:
  'Complete MICK'S letter to PETER.'

  (15-mashqdagi xat esa haqiqatan Piterdan
   Mikka edi — kitob ikkalasini adashtirgan.)


KO'RSATMALAR (4 ta):
  thieves/think/someone/be/home
  thieves/not get into/house/easily
  keep/jewellery/money/bank
  thieves/be/usually/scared/dogs


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  thieves CAN'T GET INTO the house EASILY
 2  thieves ARE USUALLY SCARED OF dogs
 3  KEEP your JEWELLERY and MONEY in the BANK
 4  thieves WILL THINK SOMEONE IS AT HOME


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Peter,

  I got your letter and I think I can help you.

  First you should always lock your doors and
  windows, so THIEVES CAN'T GET INTO THE HOUSE
  EASILY.

  I think it's a good idea to buy a big guard
  dog because THIEVES ARE USUALLY SCARED OF
  DOGS.

  You should KEEP YOUR JEWELLERY AND MONEY IN
  THE BANK, so thieves can't steal it.

  Also, it's a good idea to leave some lights
  on while you are away because THIEVES WILL
  THINK SOMEONE IS AT HOME.

  I hope my advice is of some help to you.
  Let me know what happens.

                            Best wishes,
                            Mick


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Piter,

  Xatingizni oldim va menimcha sizga yordam
  bera olaman.

  Birinchidan, eshik va derazalaringizni doim
  qulflashingiz kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uyga
  oson kira olmaydi.

  Menimcha, katta qorovul it sotib olish yaxshi
  fikr, chunki o'g'rilar odatda itlardan
  qo'rqadi.

  Taqinchoq va pulingizni bankda saqlashingiz
  kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uni o'g'irlay
  olmaydi.

  Yana, uydan uzoqda bo'lganingizda ba'zi
  chiroqlarni yoqib qo'yish yaxshi fikr, chunki
  o'g'rilar uyda kimdir bor deb o'ylaydi.

  Umid qilamanki, maslahatim sizga yordam
  beradi. Nima bo'lganini menga xabar qiling.

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Mik


DIQQAT — KO'RSATMALAR TARTIBI BOShQA!

  Ro'yxatdagi tartib va bo'shliqlar tartibi
  MOS KELMAYDI:

     1-ko'rsatma (think/someone/be/home)
        →  4-bo'shliq
     2-ko'rsatma (not get into/house/easily)
        →  1-bo'shliq
     3-ko'rsatma (keep/jewellery/money/bank)
        →  3-bo'shliq
     4-ko'rsatma (be/usually/scared/dogs)
        →  2-bo'shliq

  Kitob ataylab shunday qilgan — MA'NOGA
  qarab joylashtirish kerak.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR BO'ShLIQDAN OLDINGI
QISM:

  1  'lock your doors and windows, SO ...'
     Eshikni qulflashning NATIJASI nima?
     → o'g'rilar oson kira olmaydi
     → thieves can't get into the house easily

  2  'buy a big GUARD DOG BECAUSE ...'
     Nega it sotib olish kerak?
     → o'g'rilar itlardan qo'rqadi
     → thieves are usually scared of dogs

  3  'You should ..., so thieves CAN'T STEAL
      IT.'
     'IT' nimaga ishora qiladi? Qimmatbaho
     narsaga.
     → keep your jewellery and money in the
       bank

  4  'leave some LIGHTS ON while you are away
      BECAUSE ...'
     Nega chiroq yoqib qo'yiladi?
     → o'g'rilar uyda kimdir bor deb o'ylaydi
     → thieves will think someone is at home


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  thieves/not get into/house/easily
     → 'thieves CAN'T GET INTO THE house
        easily'
     (modal 'can't' va artikl 'the' qo'shildi)

  thieves/be/usually/scared/dogs
     → 'thieves ARE usually scared OF dogs'
     ('be' → ARE; predlog 'OF' qo'shildi)

  keep/jewellery/money/bank
     → 'keep YOUR jewellery AND money IN THE
        bank'
     (egalik, bog'lovchi va predlog qo'shildi)

  thieves/think/someone/be/home
     → 'thieves WILL THINK someone IS AT home'
     ('will' va 'is' qo'shildi)


DIQQAT — 'SCARED OF':
  'to be SCARED OF something' = ... dan
  qo'rqmoq (predlog 'OF')

  Shu kabi: afraid OF, frightened OF,
  terrified OF


DIQQAT — 'AT HOME':
  'someone is AT HOME' = uyda kimdir bor

  'at home' — turg'un ibora, artikl YO'Q
  ('at the home' XATO).


DIQQAT — 'GET INTO':
  'get INTO the house' = uyga kirmoq
  15-mashqdagi savol ham shunday edi:
  'How did the thieves GET IN?'


DIQQAT — 'A GUARD DOG':
  'a guard dog' = qorovul it
  'to guard' = qo'riqlamoq


DIQQAT — 'IS OF SOME HELP':
  'I hope my advice IS OF SOME HELP to you.'
  = maslahatim sizga biroz yordam beradi
  degan umiddaman

  'to be of help' — rasmiy ibora.


XAT TUZILIShI (Mikning javob xati):
  Murojaat:  Dear Peter,
  Kirish:    'I got your letter and I think
              I can help you.'
  4 ta MASLAHAT + har birining SABABI
  Yakun:     'I hope my advice is of some help
              ... Let me know what happens.'
  Imzo:      Best wishes, Mick


MASLAHAT ShAKLLARI XATDA:
  'you SHOULD always lock ...'      (1)
  'I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO buy ...' (2)
  'You SHOULD keep ...'             (3)
  'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO leave ...'   (4)

  Ya'ni ikki xil shakl navbatma-navbat —
  99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lock          = qulflamoq
  easily           = oson
  a guard dog      = qorovul it
  to be scared of  = ... dan qo'rqmoq
  jewellery        = taqinchoqlar
  a bank           = bank
  lights           = chiroqlar
  away             = uzoqda, yo'q
  to be of help    = yordam bermoq
  Let me know      = Menga xabar bering

points.en: 1  First you should always lock your doors and windows, so THIEVES CAN'T GET INTO THE HOUSE EASILY.
points.uz: Birinchidan, eshik va derazalaringizni doim qulflashingiz kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uyga oson kira olmaydi.
points.noteUz:
KO'RSATMA: thieves/not get into/house/easily

'SO' — natija: qulflashning natijasi.
Qo'shilgan: modal 'CAN'T' va artikl 'THE'.

Ro'yxatda bu IKKINCHI ko'rsatma edi —
tartib mos kelmaydi!

points.en: 2  I think it's a good idea to buy a big guard dog because THIEVES ARE USUALLY SCARED OF DOGS.
points.uz: Menimcha, katta qorovul it sotib olish yaxshi fikr, chunki o'g'rilar odatda itlardan qo'rqadi.
points.noteUz:
KO'RSATMA: thieves/be/usually/scared/dogs

'BECAUSE' — sabab: nega it kerak.
Qo'shilgan: 'be' → ARE, predlog 'OF'.

'to be SCARED OF' — predlog 'of' SHART.
'a guard dog' = qorovul it.

points.en: 3  You should KEEP YOUR JEWELLERY AND MONEY IN THE BANK, so thieves can't steal it.
points.uz: Taqinchoq va pulingizni bankda saqlashingiz kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uni o'g'irlay olmaydi.
points.noteUz:
KO'RSATMA: keep/jewellery/money/bank

KALIT: 'so thieves can't steal IT' — 'IT'
qimmatbaho narsaga ishora qiladi.

Qo'shilgan: 'YOUR', 'AND', 'IN THE'.
15-mashqdagi xatda o'g'rilar aynan
taqinchoq va pulni o'g'irlagan edi.

points.en: 4  Also, it's a good idea to leave some lights on while you are away because THIEVES WILL THINK SOMEONE IS AT HOME.
points.uz: Yana, uydan uzoqda bo'lganingizda ba'zi chiroqlarni yoqib qo'yish yaxshi fikr, chunki o'g'rilar uyda kimdir bor deb o'ylaydi.
points.noteUz:
KO'RSATMA: thieves/think/someone/be/home

'BECAUSE' — sabab: nega chiroq yoqib
qo'yiladi.
Qo'shilgan: 'WILL' va 'IS'.

'AT HOME' — artikl YO'Q (turg'un ibora).

Ro'yxatda bu BIRINCHI ko'rsatma edi, lekin
OXIRGI bo'shliqqa tushadi.

patterns.formula: Do I have to + [fe'l]?  —  Yes you do. You MUST + [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: Do I have to go to school? — Yes you do. You must go to school.
patterns.exampleUz: Maktabga borishim shartmi? — Ha, shart. Maktabga borishingiz kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must'.
CB 101-bet, 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.

patterns.exampleEn: Nobody heard anything. Nobody saw anything.
patterns.exampleUz: Hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi. Hech kim hech narsa ko'rmadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'nobody' allaqachon inkor, shuning uchun
keyingi so'z 'anything' ('nothing' EMAS).

patterns.exampleEn: Why didn't anybody hear anything? — Because they live quite far from the other houses.
patterns.exampleUz: Nega hech kim eshitmadi? — Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob.
DIQQAT: javobda olmoshlar UCHINCHI shaxsga
o'zgaradi ('we' → 'they').

patterns.exampleEn: You should lock your doors, so thieves can't get into the house easily. Buy a guard dog because thieves are usually scared of dogs.
patterns.exampleUz: Eshiklaringizni qulflang, shunda o'g'rilar oson kira olmaydi. Qorovul it oling, chunki o'g'rilar itlardan qo'rqadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'SO' — NATIJA;  'BECAUSE' — SABAB.
Maslahat xatining asosiy qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: Thieves are usually scared of dogs.
patterns.explanationUz:
Predlog 'OF' SHART.
Shu kabi: afraid of, frightened of.
